analysis.title_zh: Granite Switch 4.1：通过单一端点处理对话、决策与语音转写
analysis.summary: 【公告原文摘要】Granite Switch 4.1 延续模块化模型开发路线，让模型通过单一托管端点切换自然语言回答、通用及专用决策、语音转文字任务。公告列出 Granite-Switch-4.1-8B 和 -30B，配置包括新增通用决策 Decision aLoRA 与专用 Guardian aLoRA，并称其 ASR 模型在 OpenASR 排行榜上速度最快。所给文本已截断，无法确认 Guardian 的完整比较结果及测试条件。
analysis.application: 建议：【科研迁移建议】可探索将运维语音记录转写、自然语言问答与告警决策接入统一工作流；这些是迁移设想，并非公告已验证的科研效果。【官方效果声明】原文称其 ASR 模型在 OpenASR 排行榜上速度最快，但所给资料未提供测试配置，不能据此推断实际运维场景的速度、准确率或可靠性。
evidence: the Granite Switch project enables a modular approach to model development.

Now Granite Switch 4.1 models, armed with a Decision adapter and the fastest ASR model on the OpenASR leaderboard, can move efficiently between natural-language responses, general and specialized decisions, and speech-to-text tasks—all from one hosted endpoint.
Specifically, Granite-Switch-4.1-8B and -30B models are configured to include:
A new Decision aLoRA for general-purpose decision-making (e.g. v1/systemone)
